purpose: Local integration checks, not scientific qualification or a telescope protocol
normalization: Add to raw synthetic powers, then recompute the unchanged ascending 4096-channel median/MAD normalization
calibration_fixture_note: The first pure-Gaussian development run correctly stopped because some conditional scramble maxima were nonfinite. A synthetic native comb supplies eligible calibration cells. This is an arithmetic fixture, not a representative noise model or tail qualification.
truth_association: After detection only: maximum literal ON-track separation <= 2 native channel spacings, and member active epochs a subset of the injected ON epochs; all widths accepted
case_background_reuse: All six evaluation cases reuse one synthetic noise cadence; they are not six independent null realizations
